product_summary: A Korean-first mobile fashion curation app that calibrates a user's style direction through an occasion pulse, closet memory, and one bounded accent decision before shopping.
audiences: 출근 후 약속이나 전시, 모임처럼 상황이 자주 바뀌는 20-30대 모바일 패션 사용자
상품 피드를 오래 훑기보다 오늘 옷차림의 무드와 포인트를 먼저 정하고 싶은 사용자
보유 옷을 최대한 살리면서 하나의 부족한 색감, 소재, 실루엣만 후보로 보고 싶은 사용자

application_concept.primary_job: 사용자가 오늘의 상황과 보유 옷 기억을 기준으로 취향 좌표를 조정하고, 하나의 실루엣 방향과 부족한 포인트 아이템을 확정한다.
application_concept.success_moment: 사용자가 현재 취향 좌표와 실루엣 방향을 저장하고, 부족한 포인트 하나만 후보로 넘긴 상태.
differentiation: 첫 화면은 착장 완성 보드가 아니라 취향 좌표를 조정하는 style compass다.
쇼핑 후보는 무한 피드가 아니라 현재 좌표에 맞는 accent tray 안에서만 등장한다.
보유 옷은 상품 카드가 아니라 closet tape의 기억 토큰으로 표시된다.
구매보다 먼저 오늘의 스타일 강도, 대비, 소재 균형을 확정한다.

layout_skeleton.composition: style compass with closet tape and accent tray
layout_skeleton.navigation_model: bottom mode tabs with fixed decision dock

primary_regions.name: Occasion pulse
primary_regions.role: 오늘의 장소, 시간, 날씨, 드레스 기대치를 한 줄 신호로 압축

primary_regions.name: Style compass
primary_regions.role: quiet-bold, soft-sharp 축을 조정해 현재 착장 방향을 결정

primary_regions.name: Closet tape
primary_regions.role: 보유 옷을 작은 기억 토큰으로 보여 주며 추천의 출발점을 고정

primary_regions.name: Silhouette preview
primary_regions.role: 현재 좌표가 만드는 실루엣과 소재 인상을 시각적으로 확인

primary_regions.name: Accent tray
primary_regions.role: 부족한 색감, 소재, 포인트 후보를 작게 비교

primary_regions.name: Decision dock
primary_regions.role: 좌표 저장 또는 포인트 하나를 후보로 넘기는 thumb-zone 액션

first_screen_contract: 첫 viewport 안에 occasion pulse, style compass, closet tape, silhouette preview의 일부가 함께 보여야 함
상품 피드나 product grid가 style compass보다 먼저 나오면 실패
accent tray는 세 개 이하의 후보만 보여야 함
decision dock은 thumb zone에 고정되어 저장과 후보 액션을 제공해야 함
이미지는 장식 배경이 아니라 의류, 소재, 실루엣 판단에 쓰여야 함
avoid_layouts: Foldline-style look board with contextual shop sheet
horizontal filter chip row as primary control

signature_moves: The first interactive object is a two-axis style compass, not a garment board.
Closet memory appears as a continuous tape of owned garment tokens.
Commerce appears only as a bounded accent tray with one shortlist action.
The bottom decision dock saves the calibration itself, not a product card.
Fit information is shown as a compact passport attached to the calibrated silhouette.
repetition_risks: falling back to daily brief plus large outfit image
using product cards for every garment
turning compass values into dashboard metrics
making the accent tray look like a marketplace carousel

component_decision.rationale: Tinge needs a calibration instrument: occasion pulse, style compass, closet tape, silhouette preview, accent tray, and a fixed decision dock. Generic product grids, look boards, dashboards, and modal commerce are excluded so the app stays about deciding style direction before shopping.

core_components.name: app-shell
core_components.role: Constrains the mobile calibration instrument and fixed thumb-zone controls.
core_components.decision_reason: The experience needs a phone-scale tool frame, not a desktop dashboard shell.

core_components.name: status-topline
core_components.role: Shows brand, date, place, and compact entry actions.
core_components.decision_reason: The top line orients the calibration without becoming a marketing header.

core_components.name: occasion-pulse
core_components.role: Compresses situation constraints into a readable pulse.
core_components.decision_reason: This replaces generic filters with context signals the compass can respond to.

core_components.name: pulse-token
core_components.role: Displays one live context signal such as weather, venue, or dress expectation.
core_components.decision_reason: Signals should feel like live calibration inputs, not filter chips.

core_components.name: compass-stage
core_components.role: Holds the axis grid, handle, and current style direction.
core_components.decision_reason: The compass is the primary product object and must be its own component.

core_components.name: compass-axis
core_components.role: Labels the quiet-bold and soft-sharp style axes.
core_components.decision_reason: Axis language explains the decision better than categories or tabs.

core_components.name: compass-handle
core_components.role: Lets the user move the current style direction across the compass.
core_components.decision_reason: The user's main action is calibration, so the handle must be a real control.

core_components.name: temperature-band
core_components.role: Shows the warm-cool and rain-ready material bias for the current direction.
core_components.decision_reason: This is product feedback, not a dashboard metric.

core_components.name: closet-tape
core_components.role: Displays owned garments as a continuous memory strip.
core_components.decision_reason: Owned items should feel like memory evidence, not commerce cards.

core_components.name: closet-token
core_components.role: Represents one owned garment with color, material, and recency.
core_components.decision_reason: A token keeps the closet compact and tactile.

core_components.name: silhouette-preview
core_components.role: Shows the calibrated silhouette direction through garment imagery.
core_components.decision_reason: The app needs a visual read of shape, not a product tile.

core_components.name: silhouette-layer
core_components.role: Names the base, texture, and accent layers inside the preview.
core_components.decision_reason: Layer labels connect the image to closet and accent decisions.

core_components.name: calibration-meter
core_components.role: Shows restraint, contrast, and walkability as calibrated bars.
core_components.decision_reason: These values explain the direction but must not become dashboard stats.

core_components.name: contrast-slider
core_components.role: Adjusts visual contrast without leaving the first screen.
core_components.decision_reason: Contrast is a fashion decision control, not a generic settings input.

core_components.name: accent-tray
core_components.role: Shows a small bounded set of missing accent candidates.
core_components.decision_reason: Commerce enters only as a bounded tray after calibration.

core_components.name: accent-swatch
core_components.role: Lets the user choose one accent by color, material, and role.
core_components.decision_reason: The candidate should feel like an accent decision, not a product card.

core_components.name: fit-passport
core_components.role: Summarizes fit risk, movement, hem length, and outerwear compatibility.
core_components.decision_reason: Fit details need a compact passport tied to the silhouette.

core_components.name: fit-measure-row
core_components.role: Shows one fit measure and its status.
core_components.decision_reason: Fit should be scan-friendly without becoming a table.

core_components.name: restraint-note
core_components.role: Explains why the current direction stops at one accent.
core_components.decision_reason: The product promise is restraint before shopping.

core_components.name: decision-dock
core_components.role: Keeps save and shortlist actions fixed in the thumb zone.
core_components.decision_reason: The user should commit the style direction without hunting for a CTA.

core_components.name: save-calibration-action
core_components.role: Saves the current compass direction and closet match.
core_components.decision_reason: Saving calibration is the primary success action.

core_components.name: bottom-mode-tabs
core_components.role: Switches between tune, closet, saved, and candidates modes.
core_components.decision_reason: Mode navigation belongs at the bottom for one-handed mobile use.

core_components.name: confirmation-pill
core_components.role: Confirms that calibration or accent shortlist has been saved.
core_components.decision_reason: Confirmation should be small and reversible, not a modal.

rejected_components.name: look-board
rejected_components.reason: Would recreate the previous Foldline direction instead of the new compass skeleton.

rejected_components.name: shop-sheet
rejected_components.reason: Commerce should stay as a bounded accent tray, not a bottom sheet.

rejected_components.name: product-grid
rejected_components.reason: A grid would turn calibration into generic shopping.

rejected_components.name: product-card
rejected_components.reason: Accent decisions should not look like marketplace cards.

rejected_components.name: hero-cta-group
rejected_components.reason: The app opens on a working calibration surface.

rejected_components.name: dashboard-card
rejected_components.reason: Calibration feedback is not an operations dashboard.

rejected_components.name: filter-chip
rejected_components.reason: Pulse tokens and compass controls replace generic filters.

rejected_components.name: modal-dialog
rejected_components.reason: The first flow should avoid interruptive modal commerce.

rejected_components.name: infinite-feed
rejected_components.reason: The product is about narrowing to one accent, not browsing endlessly.

notes: Use color reference as semantic evidence only.
Do not ship a fixed preset palette.
Keep the palette mixed across ink, red, teal, green, citrus, and warm surface tones.
Product IA and component selection are governed by component_decision.
